postCleanupOrder: outer close/exact command/environment and bounded raw streams
closed supervisor shape and retained status oracle
ordinary bounded exact capture filenames and all bytes
supervisor root PID matches decoded record PID
exact raw/cwd/image/env/argv UTF16 oracle fields; only nonzero PID/time are runtime placeholders
holdEvidence: marker-closed stop + forced job termination is consistent with hold; does not measure every instruction or complete attempt count
pollingPrecedence: closed marker bad length/magic => stop invalid
freshRoot: hardcoded source root; never reuse after even failed run; later runs need separate source/binary/root design
failureRetention: retain all bounded originals/raw files; partial/unknown/aliases reject; no delete/retry
firstWinner: exclusive entry then winner; no reelection after partial/stale winner; only observable registrations count
limitations: first smoke cannot validate real concurrent race ordering or injected IO failure
unregistered/pre-entry failures and late terminations remain uncounted
synthetic UTF16/API argv expectations are not an observation of Windows
no PE interpretation or source-to-binary equivalence claim
